exposure: Application of Sepsis Risk Calculator (SRC) recommendations
outcome: False-positive indications for treatment by SRC
EONS cases identified for treatment by SRC
cohort: Late preterm and term newborns who received antibiotics from 2019 to 2020 in a tertiary Belgian hospital were included.
finding: In this Belgian cohort, use of the Sepsis Risk Calculator (SRC) has the potential to significantly decrease by 64.5% the newborns that receive antibiotics, primarily concerning asymptomatic newborns.
